Hive.mechanics: Adaptive evolution, biological population, poison, armor, flyers, parasites, creep-like support.
Hive.strengths: Replacement rate, flexible evolution, attrition, population scaling.
Hive.weaknesses: Area damage, burst attacks on Queen/Nexus, dependence on biological synergy.

Cultists.mechanics: Death economy, necromancy, curses, sacrifices, pacts, demon summoning.
Cultists.strengths: Value from death, disruptive curses, revival, explosive ritual spikes.
Cultists.weaknesses: Setup costs, sacrifice risks, anti-summon/holy pressure, weaker clean economy.

Humans.mechanics: Training, formation, equipment-like research, holy support, engineering, tame neutral beasts.
Humans.strengths: Reliable combined arms, defense, healing, ranged focus, adaptable neutral integration.
Humans.weaknesses: Higher unit costs, vulnerable economy structures, less extreme scaling without specialization.
